skill.name: gws-sheets-append
skill.description: Append rows to a Google Sheets spreadsheet using the gws command-line tool.
skill.summary: Append simple or structured row data to Google Sheets from an AI assistant workflow.
skill.author: googleworkspace

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md. Most static backtick findings are Markdown formatting, but the skill intentionally runs gws commands that append data to Google Sheets. The line 16 sibling-file prerequisite crosses the skill boundary and should be made package-safe.

remediation.issue: External write command can modify cloud spreadsheet data.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation that includes the spreadsheet ID, target range, and a brief value summary before running gws sheets +append.

remediation.issue: The skill references a sibling path outside its package.
remediation.suggestion: Package shared guidance with the skill or use a marketplace-supported include mechanism instead of ../ paths.

remediation.issue: Caller-provided values can include sensitive information.
remediation.suggestion: Review values for secrets and personal data before appending, and reject untrusted spreadsheet IDs unless the user confirms ownership.

content.value_statement: Manual spreadsheet updates slow teams and create copy errors. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code append reviewed row data through the gws CLI.
actual_capabilities: Append a row to a Google Sheets spreadsheet by spreadsheet ID.
Send simple comma-separated values with the --values flag.
Send multiple rows with the --json-values flag.
Target a specific sheet tab or range with A1 notation.
Use the gws CLI and its existing Google Workspace authentication.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Requires a valid spreadsheet ID before any append operation.
Does not describe duplicate detection, schema checks, or rollback behavior.
Writes data to Google Sheets, so user confirmation is required.

use_cases.title: Log Support Outcomes
use_cases.description: Append reviewed ticket summaries, status values, and owner names to a shared operations spreadsheet.

use_cases.title: Track Research Entries
use_cases.description: Add normalized source notes or experiment rows to a team spreadsheet after the user approves each entry.

use_cases.title: Update Project Registers
use_cases.description: Append project milestones, dates, and ownership details to a planning sheet from assistant-managed work notes.

prompt_templates.title: Append One Reviewed Row
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one safe spreadsheet update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Append this approved row to my Google Sheet: name Alice, score 100, active true. Confirm the spreadsheet ID and values before running.

prompt_templates.title: Append to a Specific Tab
prompt_templates.scenario: Add a row to a named worksheet tab.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add this row to the Sheet2 tab of my spreadsheet: Alice, 100. Show the target range and ask for confirmation first.

prompt_templates.title: Append Multiple Rows
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a bulk append after the user reviews rows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare two rows for my spreadsheet from these records, then ask me to approve the final rows before appending them.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Before Append
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with safety checks before a write operation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check these rows for missing fields, possible secrets, and the correct column order. Then append only after I confirm the destination spreadsheet.

output_examples.input: Append Alice, 100, true to my spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: I will confirm the spreadsheet ID, summarize the row, and append it only after approval.

output_examples.input: Add two approved research rows to the Lab Notes tab.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares the rows, names the target tab, requests confirmation, and reports the append result.

output_examples.input: Append customer feedback notes to the shared tracker.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks for sensitive data, asks for destination confirmation, and appends the reviewed notes.

best_practices: Confirm the spreadsheet ID, tab, and row values before every write.
Review row data for secrets, personal data, and formatting issues.
Use structured rows when appending more than one record.
anti_patterns: Do not append data to a spreadsheet ID provided by an untrusted source without verification.
Do not run the write command before the user approves the exact values.
Do not use this skill as a replacement for validation, deduplication, or audit logging.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant to append row data to Google Sheets using the gws command-line tool.

faq.question: Does it require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated before the append command can work.

faq.question: Can it append more than one row?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents a structured values option for multiple rows.

faq.question: Can it choose a specific sheet tab?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented range option can target a sheet tab with A1 notation.

faq.question: Is user confirmation required?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is a write operation and should confirm the destination and values before execution.

faq.question: Does it validate spreadsheet schemas?
faq.answer: No. The skill does not describe schema validation, duplicate checks, or rollback behavior.
